reason: 'to stretch out' is the same spatial-extension sense as the existing 'to spread / to extend' (扩大); the sea sentence reads fine off the current line.
The sun setting is the ordinary 'to sink / to go under' sense applied to the sun; ZH 降下 already covers descending.
'to stop or refrain from doing' is exactly the existing 'to cease' (停止 / 作罢).
'to be filled with' restates 'to be full'; ZH 充满 is literally that.
Battery/time/stock 切れる means 'to run out, be used up'. Neither 'to break / to snap' nor 断 / 切断 conveys that; a learner would read the sentence as the battery physically breaking.
'to knock down or cause to fall' is the existing 'to throw down' (弄倒).
Threading a needle is the existing causative 'to let pass' / 让通过 with the thread as the thing passed through.
'with a sweet smile' is the adverbial restatement of 'smile sweetly' (微微一笑).
'to become engaged' is the する-verb form of the noun 'engagement / betrothal' (订婚), not a distinct sense.
'manufacturing of goods' restates 'manufacture / production' (制造 / 生产).
A typhoon 去る is the plain 'to leave / to go away' sense (离去); no weather-specific meaning is involved.
'to save a life' bolts the sentence's object (患者の命) onto the word; the sense itself is already 'to rescue from' (拯救).
'repair of a bicycle' describes the sentence's object, not a sense of 修理.
'border between countries' is a wordier 'national border' (国境 / 边境).
'circle formed by people' describes the sentence; the word's sense is just 'ring / circle' (环 / 圈).
'other people' is verbatim the existing 'another person / others' (别人 / 他人).
'aspect or side' is already carried by ZH 方面, which is the exact gloss for 肯定的な面.
'one's share or portion' is already carried by ZH 份 and EN 'part'.
〜た末に is the existing 'the end of' (末尾 / 最后) in a temporal usage; 'end result after effort' describes the construction, and the current line still reads correctly.
'diagram or illustration' is the existing 'figure / drawing' (图 / 图表).
EN line 'needle / pin' does not reach a clock's hands; a learner would misread 時計の針. (Note: ZH 指针 already covers it, so only the EN line actually gains.)
Gristle/sinew in meat is already covered by ZH 筋 (肉筋), the same word the Chinese sentence uses.
'apology or I am sorry' is the existing 'I beg your pardon / excuse me' (对不起 / 抱歉).
Visiting a sick person is exactly the existing sense; ZH 探望 is the standard gloss for a sickbed visit.
EN line 'unit / denomination' does not reach university credits; a learner would misread 単位を取る. (Note: ZH 学分 already covers it, so only the EN line actually gains.)
'to sell in large quantities' is the existing 'to sell well' (畅销).
'female parent' is the existing 'mother' (母亲).
'sudden violent bursting' restates 'explosion / detonation' (爆炸).
'seven day period' restates 'week' (周 / 星期).
'bound away from the hub' is precisely the existing 'down-train' / 下行.
'mechanical device or system' is the existing 'equipment / installation' (装置 / 设备).
